Globe geography: Natural Earth, public domain.
https://www.naturalearthdata.com/about/terms-of-use/
Source: https://github.com/nvkelso/natural-earth-vector/blob/ca96624a56bd078437bca8184e78163e5039ad19/geojson/ne_110m_admin_0_countries.geojson
Derived by retaining polygon rings and rounding coordinates to three decimal places.

GeoIP: IP.SB online API, backed by MaxMind GeoIP according to its documentation.
https://ip.sb/api/
No GeoIP database is embedded. Coordinates are approximate.
